newsitem.title: UK: HBSC London rise echoes Hong Kong market.
newsitem.headline: HBSC London rise echoes Hong Kong market.

text.p: Shares in HSBC Holdings Plc rose on Friday in the wake of gains in Hong Kong, where half the shares of the banking group are owned, traders said.
The stock was up 11p at 11.75 stg by 0820 GMT in modest trade of 512,353 shares.
"They're trading up a little bit," one dealer said. "It's not unusual. They traded up well in Hong Kong and it's to make up for that."
Another said today's gain could reflect a single large buy order. "It's hardly a big move," he said. "At 12 quid (stg) a throw it only needs one big buyer to move it up that much."
